---
title: Unused group
format:
  typst: default
filters:
  - veil
extensions:
  veil:
    state: "-hidden"
    groups:
      - name: used
      - name: hidden
      - name: nested
      - name: idle
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        warnings: exhaustive
    typst:
      noErrors: true
      printsMessage:
        - level: WARN
          regex: "The group 'idle' is declared in the option groups but no element uses it"
          count: 1
---
